summary: A role-based recessed/downlight design and estimating workspace where electricians create persistent projects, rooms, lighting layouts, product selections and estimates, while admins manage users, roles and default settings.

journeys.title: An electrician signs in, creates a lighting project, designs a room layout, selects a product, views an estimate and exports it

steps.expect: the sign-in form is visible and demo credentials for Admin and Electrician are shown
the dashboard is shown without admin navigation
the projects workspace and create project control are visible
the new project appears in the project list with Active status
the project detail route shows the created project name and room controls

steps.action: add a room using realistic defaults
steps.expect: the room is saved and calculation outputs are shown with units and an estimate disclaimer
area, approximate lumen requirement, required fittings, suggested rows and columns, spacing, edge spacing and any warnings are visible

steps.action: change the fitting count and recalculate the layout
steps.expect: the diagram updates to show eight proposed downlight positions

steps.action: add a manual fitting by clicking the room diagram
steps.expect: one additional fitting marker appears on the room diagram

steps.action: remove a fitting from the room diagram
steps.expect: the selected fitting marker is removed and the fitting quantity decreases
a saved state is shown and the final fitting markers remain visible
seeded downlight products are visible with manufacturer, model, wattage, lumens, beam angle and cost
the product list only shows matching products

steps.action: select a product for the room
steps.expect: the room shows the selected downlight and recalculated wattage, lumens, beam angle and material cost
the estimate summary for the current project is visible

steps.action: enter labour assumptions and calculate the estimate
steps.expect: labour cost, material cost, subtotal, total and room-by-room breakdown are visible
a downloadable CSV or text estimate file is produced for the current project
the project, room, saved layout, selected product and estimate values are still visible after reload

acceptance: a signed-in electrician can create a project and open it at /projects/:projectId
room calculations display area, lumen requirement, fitting count and layout spacing as estimates
saved layout positions, selected product and estimate totals survive a full page reload
an estimate summary can be downloaded from the current project state

journeys.title: An electrician searches, filters, renames and deletes projects

steps.expect: the sign-in form is visible
the dashboard is shown
the project search, status filter and create project controls are visible
the Draft project appears in the project list

steps.action: search by project name and filter by status
steps.expect: only matching Draft projects with Maple in the name are shown
the full project list is shown again
the project row shows the updated project name
the deleted project no longer appears in the project list

acceptance: project search filters by customer/project name
status filtering limits the list to the selected status
renamed projects show their updated name
deleted projects disappear from the project list

journeys.title: An electrician views dashboard totals for their own projects

steps.expect: dashboard metric cards are visible
project count, total rooms designed, total fittings specified and estimated value of active projects are shown

acceptance: dashboard totals reflect persisted projects and rooms owned by the signed-in electrician
dashboard value outputs are clearly labelled as design estimates

journeys.title: An electrician cannot see or open admin controls

steps.expect: the sign-in form is visible
the main navigation is visible without an Admin link
an access denied guard is shown and admin management controls are not visible

acceptance: electricians do not see admin navigation
electricians who type /admin see an access denied message
user management controls are not rendered for electricians

journeys.title: An admin manages default settings and user roles

steps.expect: the sign-in form is visible with admin demo credentials displayed
the dashboard is shown with admin navigation visible
user management and system settings panels are visible
the created preview user appears in the users table
the saved settings panel shows the updated default labour rate

steps.action: update a default lux target for a room type
steps.expect: the Kitchen default lux target shows the updated value
the selected user row shows the updated role
the updated labour rate, lux target, created user and role remain visible after reload

acceptance: admins can access the admin route
admins can create a preview user profile that appears in the users table

routes.name: Root
routes.purpose: redirect signed-out users to sign-in and signed-in users to dashboard

routes.name: Sign in
routes.purpose: email/password sign-in with visible demo account credentials and estimate disclaimer

routes.name: Dashboard
routes.purpose: show project, room, fitting and active estimate value metrics for the signed-in electrician or admin

routes.name: Projects
routes.purpose: create, search, filter, rename and delete lighting projects

routes.name: Project detail
routes.purpose: manage rooms, calculations, layout editor and product selection for a project

routes.name: Estimate summary
routes.purpose: show room-by-room project summary, cost totals and estimate export controls

routes.name: Products catalogue
routes.purpose: browse, search and filter seeded downlight products

routes.name: Admin area
routes.purpose: admin-only management of users, roles and system settings with an access denied guard for electricians

entities.name: userProfile
relationships: a user profile represents one authenticated user or admin-created preview user
admins can update user profile roles

entities.name: project
relationships: a project belongs to one signed-in user
projectSearch and statusFilter are transient filter controls for the project list

entities.name: room
relationships: a room belongs to one project
a room stores its own final layout positions
a room may reference one selected product

entities.name: product
relationships: productSearch and productIpRating are transient filter controls for the catalogue

entities.name: settings
relationships: settings provide default lux targets and labour defaults

auth.model: email + password via the backend SDK
rules: projects and rooms belong to the signed-in user and are not visible to other electricians
admins can access /admin and update users, roles and settings
electricians cannot see admin navigation or admin controls
electricians who manually open /admin see Access denied

operations.description: sign in with email and password
persist a lighting project for the signed-in user
delete a project owned by the signed-in user
filter visible projects by text and status

responsibilities.behavior: return projects whose customerName contains projectSearch and whose status equals statusFilter unless the all-status option is selected

operations.description: reset project search and status filter to show all visible projects

responsibilities.behavior: clear projectSearch and statusFilter controls and return all projects visible to the signed-in user

operations.description: persist a room and calculate its initial lighting estimate and layout

responsibilities.behavior: calculate area as length times width, lumenRequirement as area times targetLux, requiredFittings as ceiling of lumenRequirement divided by lumensPerFitting, suggested rows and columns based on room proportions and fitting count, spacing over usable dimensions after edgeOffset, estimatedWattage, initial layoutPositions, and spacingWarning from beam spread and ceiling height checks

operations.description: recalculate room layout positions from a user-specified fitting count

responsibilities.behavior: use manualFittingCount to recompute rows, columns, spacing, layoutPositions, estimatedWattage and spacing warnings for the room

operations.description: add one manual fitting position to the room diagram

responsibilities.behavior: append a clicked canvas coordinate to layoutPositions and update requiredFittings and estimatedWattage

operations.description: remove one fitting position from the room diagram

responsibilities.behavior: remove the selected fitting coordinate from layoutPositions and update requiredFittings and estimatedWattage

operations.description: save final layout positions to the room
select a catalogue product for a room and update lighting and material estimate fields

responsibilities.behavior: copy selected product lumens, wattage and beam angle to the room, set selectedProductName, recalculate materialCost from fitting quantity times unitCost, recalculate estimatedWattage and spacingWarning

operations.description: filter seeded products by search text and product attributes

responsibilities.behavior: return catalogue products matching productSearch text and selected productIpRating

operations.description: calculate project-level material, labour, subtotal and total estimates from rooms and labour assumptions

responsibilities.behavior: sum room materialCost values, calculate labourCost as labourRate times estimatedInstallHours, subtotal as materialCost plus labourCost, totalCost as subtotal, and write labour assumptions to the project

operations.description: produce a downloadable CSV or text estimate summary for the current project

responsibilities.behavior: generate a downloadable estimate summary containing project name, every room, fitting quantity, selected downlight, estimated wattage, material cost, labour cost, subtotal, total and design-estimate disclaimer

operations.description: calculate visible dashboard totals from projects and rooms visible to the signed-in user

responsibilities.behavior: calculate projectCount, roomCount, fittingCount and activeProjectValue from the signed-in user's projects and rooms

operations.description: admin updates default labour settings or default lux targets

responsibilities.behavior: update the default labour rate or the selected room type lux target in the settings record

operations.description: admin creates a preview user profile for role management where safe

responsibilities.behavior: create a non-secret preview authUserId from the submitted email so the profile can be listed and role-managed in preview

integrations.name: none
integrations.purpose: all authentication, persistence and downloads use the provided backend SDK and browser capabilities

states.loading: sign-in button shows loading while authentication is pending
states.error: invalid sign-in shows a visible error message

states.loading: metric cards show skeleton values while projects and rooms load
states.empty: zero values are shown when the signed-in user has no projects
states.error: dashboard data failed to load message is visible
states.success: project, room, fitting and active project value metrics are shown with design estimate labels

states.loading: project list skeleton appears while projects load
states.empty: No projects yet is shown with a create project button
states.validation: customer/project name and status are required
states.error: saving or deleting failed, try again is shown
states.success: created or renamed project is visible in the list

states.loading: room list and calculation panels show skeletons while loading
states.empty: No rooms yet is shown with an add room form
states.validation: length, width, ceiling height, target lux, lumens, beam angle and edge offset must be positive numbers
states.error: room save failed, try again is visible
states.success: room calculation outputs and saved layout diagram are visible

states.loading: diagram placeholder appears while layout positions load
states.empty: a room diagram with no fittings shows Add fittings or recalculate layout
states.validation: manual fitting count must be a positive whole number
states.error: layout save failed, try again is visible
states.success: saved layout positions remain on the diagram

states.loading: product table skeleton appears while products load
states.empty: No matching products is shown for unmatched filters
states.validation: search accepts non-empty text and filters use listed options
states.error: products failed to load message is visible
states.success: matching products are listed with manufacturer, model, wattage, lumens, beam angle, ratings and unit cost

states.loading: estimate totals show skeleton values while rooms load
states.empty: No rooms to estimate is shown when the project has no rooms
states.validation: labour rate and estimated installation hours must be positive numbers
states.error: estimate calculation failed, try again is visible
states.success: room-by-room breakdown, subtotal, total and download control are visible

states.loading: user and settings tables show skeleton rows while loading
states.empty: No users found is shown if no profiles are available
states.validation: default labour rate and lux targets must be positive numbers and roles must be Admin or Electrician
states.error: settings or role update failed, try again is visible
states.success: updated settings and role values are shown

states.error: Access denied is shown to electricians on /admin
states.success: admins see the admin management panels

acceptance.statement: a signed-in electrician can create a project that appears in the project list and opens at /projects/:projectId
a created room shows calculated area, approximate lumen requirement, required fittings, suggested layout spacing and estimate disclaimers
edited layout positions remain visible after a page reload
selecting a catalogue product updates the room's lumens, wattage, beam angle and material cost and those values survive reload
the estimate summary shows fitting quantity, selected downlight, estimated wattage, material cost, labour cost, subtotal and total
the estimate export control produces a downloadable CSV or text file from the current project state
project search and status filters visibly limit the project list and clear filters restores the full list
electricians cannot see admin navigation and receive Access denied when opening /admin
admin updates to labour rate, lux targets and user roles remain visible after reload
dashboard cards show project count, room count, fitting count and active project value with design estimate labels
the sign-in screen visibly shows seeded Admin and Electrician demo account labels and demo credential text

deferred.reason: the app provides clearly labelled design estimates only and does not certify compliance

deferred.item: manufacturer live pricing or stock integrations
deferred.reason: the request asks for a small seeded catalogue rather than external supplier integrations
the requested scope is estimating and downloadable summary output, not billing

deferred.item: multi-user collaboration inside the same project
deferred.reason: the request defines signed-in ownership boundaries but does not require shared editing
